candidate_requirements.requirement: Request paired current and earlier thyroid results with dates, rather than TSH alone.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The opening explicitly describes a changing profile; identifying the direction and meaning requires comparing TSH with thyroid hormone measurements.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Current and serial TSH plus T4/free T4, or an equivalent dated thyroid-function review. A request for assay-verified free T4 counts even though quantitative free values are unavailable here.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request levothyroxine dose/administration and cancer-treatment or surgical timing.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The task concerns results obtained during replacement and cancer treatment; exposure and dosing changes are needed to interpret the pattern.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A medication review including replacement dose, adherence/administration and immunotherapy or relevant surgery chronology. No exact brand-name guess is required.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek assay clarification and further pituitary/adrenal evidence when the paired results raise concern for central dysfunction.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Discordant hormone and TSH behaviour leaves consequential alternatives unresolved; the review should identify how they could be distinguished.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Verification of free-hormone assay/units and an appropriate endocrine/pituitary-adrenal evaluation request. Unavailable later reports do not make the request inadequate.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.
